SELECT sum(try_cast(total_comp_action_amt AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_environment.echo_case_enforcements
How did the number of reactions taken from published applications change from 2002 to 2015?
SELECT cast(year AS varchar) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.uspto_reactions_applications WHERE cast(year AS varchar) IN ('2002', '2015') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which counties in New York have the highest median household income?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS median_income FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 AS a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_5yr AS g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0500000US36%' AND a.variable = 'B19013_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many corrective action plans are on file with the audit clearinghouse?
What form types made up most of EDGAR's 2021 filings?
SELECT form_type, count(*) AS filings FROM govblock_sec.edgar_index_master WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2021' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many master reactions does Rhea define?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_rhea_directions
Which states lost the most pedestrians to traffic crashes in 2022?
SELECT statename, count(*) AS pedestrians_killed FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_person WHERE per_typ = '5' AND inj_sev = '4' AND cast(death_yr AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many water discharge inspections were carried out by EPA itself rather than a state?
SELECT count(*) AS inspections FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_inspections WHERE state_epa_flag = 'E'
Which towns in Wisconsin have the most eligible voters?
SELECT geoname, try_cast(cvap_est AS double) AS citizens_18_plus FROM govblock_elections.cvap_mcd WHERE lntitle = 'Total' AND geoname LIKE '%, Wisconsin' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many companies filed an electric quarterly report for the second quarter of 2016?
SELECT count(DISTINCT company_id_ferc) AS companies FROM govblock_energy.ferceqr_quarterly_identity WHERE year_quarter = '2016q2'
Which employers' benefit plans covered the most participants in plan year 2000?

SELECT sponsor_dfe_name, sum(try_cast(tot_partcp_boy_cnt AS double)) AS participants FROM govblock_nonprofits.dol_f_5500 WHERE substr(form_plan_year_begin_date, 1, 4) = '2000' AND sponsor_dfe_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the molecular formula of caffeine?
SELECT m.c1 AS formula FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mass AS m JOIN govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_title AS t ON t.c0 = m.c0 WHERE t.c1 = 'Caffeine'
Which countries outside the United States produce the most patented inventions?
SELECT raw_country, count(*) AS locations FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_location_not_disambiguated WHERE raw_country <> 'US' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Did wind or hydro supply more of New York's power in 2023?

SELECT fuel_category, round(sum(try_cast(gen_mw AS double)) / 12) AS mwh FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_fuel_mix_rtfuelmix WHERE fuel_category IN ('Wind', 'Hydro') AND substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which congressional districts reach into the most counties?

SELECT s.usps || '-' || substr(r.geoid_cd119_20, 3, 2) AS district, count(DISTINCT r.geoid_county_20) AS counties FROM govblock_census.rel2020_tab20_cd11920_county20 r JOIN govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_state s ON s.geoid = substr(r.geoid_cd119_20, 1, 2) WHERE try_cast(r.arealand_part AS double) > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Medicare-enrolled hospitals have a private equity owner?
SELECT count(DISTINCT enrollment_id) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_hospital_all_owners WHERE private_equity_company_owner = 'Y'
Which utilities operate the most generators?
SELECT utility_name, count(DISTINCT plant_code || '-' || generator_id) AS generators FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many judicial confirmations were there each year from 2005 to 2014?

SELECT substr(cast(date_confirmation AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS confirmations FROM govblock_courts.people_db_positions WHERE substr(cast(date_confirmation AS varchar), 1, 4) BETWEEN '2005' AND '2014' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which political organizations reported the most itemised contributions?
SELECT column03 AS organization, sum(try_cast(column15 AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_nonprofits.pol_org_8872_contributions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many patent rejections cite the Supreme Court's Alice decision?
SELECT count(*) AS rejections FROM govblock_patents.oa_research_rejections WHERE alice_in = '1'
Which states produced the most utility-scale solar power in 2024?

SELECT substr(series_id, 14, 2) AS state, try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id LIKE 'ELEC.GEN.SUN-%-99.A' AND length(series_id) = 20 AND substr(series_id, 14, 2) <> 'US' AND period = '2024' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many categories of federal award does USAspending distinguish?
Which New York counties have the largest land area?
SELECT name, max(try_cast(aland_sqmi AS double)) AS land_sq_mi FROM govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_counties WHERE usps = 'NY' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many pieces of research software are archived in the Zenodo collection?
SELECT count(*) AS records FROM govblock_scholarly.zenodo_records WHERE resource_type_general = 'Software'
Which states received the most federal grant and loan dollars in fiscal year 2022?

SELECT recipient_state_code, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_assistance WHERE cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did the federal government owe in 1790?
SELECT try_cast(debt_outstanding_amt AS double) AS debt FROM govblock_treasury.debt_outstanding WHERE record_date = '1790-01-01'
How has Veterans Affairs contract spending in Florida changed from 2018 to 2025?

SELECT action_date_fiscal_year, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE awarding_agency_name = 'DEPARTMENT OF VETERANS AFFAIRS' AND primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'FL' AND action_date_fiscal_year BETWEEN '2018' AND '2025' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10
How many insider reports filed in 2021 were amendments to earlier Form 4s?
SELECT count(*) AS amendments FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_submission WHERE document_type = '4/A' AND filing_date LIKE '%-2021'
How old is the average operating nuclear reactor?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(current_reactor_age AS double)), 1) AS avg_age_years FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_dataset_reactors_operating_query_1
How many federal contract actions went to companies in Buffalo in fiscal year 2025?
SELECT count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE upper(recipient_city_name) = 'BUFFALO' AND recipient_state_code = 'NY' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2025'
How many Medicaid prescriptions were filled in New York in 2021?
SELECT sum(try_cast(number_of_prescriptions AS double)) AS prescriptions FROM govblock_health.medicaid_sdud WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2021' AND state = 'NY'
How did the average U.S. residential electricity price change from 2004 to 2024?
SELECT period, try_cast(value AS double) AS cents_per_kwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id = 'ELEC.PRICE.US-RES.A' AND period IN ('2004', '2024') ORDER BY 1
How many fatal crashes in 2022 happened at railroad crossings?
SELECT count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' AND rail NOT IN ('0000000', '9999999', '')
Which technology classes hold the most published patent applications?

SELECT c.cpc_subclass, t.title, count(*) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.pv_pg_cpc_current c LEFT JOIN (SELECT cpc_subclass, max(cpc_subclass_title) AS title FROM govblock_patents.pv_pg_cpc_title GROUP BY 1) t ON t.cpc_subclass = c.cpc_subclass WHERE c.cpc_sequence = '0' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many generating technologies does the Annual Technology Baseline cover?
SELECT count(DISTINCT technology_alias) AS n FROM govblock_energy.oedi_atb_atbe
